title: Pique Macho
description: Pique Macho is a dish from Bolivia featuring beef sirloin, potato, fresh pork sausage, yellow onion. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 14 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 16 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 9 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Fry the eggs over medium heat until the whites are set and the yolks reach the desired safely cooked firmness; use a lightly oiled non-stick pan.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
